rustcraft.handbook.title: Engineer's Handbook
rustcraft.handbook.given: You have the Engineer's Handbook: a right click opens it
rustcraft.handbook.page.overview.name: What RustCraft is
rustcraft.handbook.page.overview.sum: A tech mod about tidy automation: one magistral inside the base, a monorail between bases, worker carts and a single storage.
rustcraft.handbook.page.quickstart.name: The first hour
rustcraft.handbook.page.quickstart.sum: From the first copper and iron to a working line from ore to ingots.
rustcraft.handbook.page.progress.name: Progression and alloys
rustcraft.handbook.page.progress.sum: Four tiers. Make a tier's alloy to open it: the first on a crafting table, the others in the alloy smelter.
rustcraft.handbook.page.glossary.name: Glossary
rustcraft.handbook.page.glossary.sum: Words that come up all through the handbook.
rustcraft.handbook.page.xp.name: Experience from machines
rustcraft.handbook.page.xp.sum: A machine brings its owner half the experience they would get doing the same work by hand.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tree_perks.name: The tree speeds up machines
rustcraft.handbook.page.tree_perks.sum: The higher the owner's level in a branch of the skill tree, the faster their machines of that branch work: up to half again.
rustcraft.handbook.page.housing.name: Magistral Housing
rustcraft.handbook.page.housing.sum: A pipe block. Every housing has three channels built in, for items, fluid and energy; its tier sets how much they carry.
rustcraft.handbook.page.node.name: Magistral Node
rustcraft.handbook.page.node.sum: The magistral's relay and crossing. It extends the line by its range. Nodes of tiers 1–3 pass the line straight through; a tier 4 node is a junction.
rustcraft.handbook.page.facade.name: Facade
rustcraft.handbook.page.facade.sum: Hides a magistral housing: the whole housing looks like an ordinary block such as stone, planks or bricks.
rustcraft.handbook.page.wrench.name: Wrench
rustcraft.handbook.page.wrench.sum: Sets up joints, the places where a housing touches a machine or a chest. Turns and takes up machines.
rustcraft.handbook.page.orders.name: Smart Magistral
rustcraft.handbook.page.orders.sum: Machines say what they lack and the storage hands it out. Order an item from the terminal and the magistral makes it on its own.
rustcraft.handbook.page.crystal.name: Energy Crystal
rustcraft.handbook.page.crystal.sum: A little energy, always and for free. The first source of a base.
rustcraft.handbook.page.structure.name: Crystal Structure
rustcraft.handbook.page.structure.sum: Crystals placed as a solid block give far more than the same crystals apart, as long as they get nutrient solution.
rustcraft.handbook.page.grow.name: Growing Crystals
rustcraft.handbook.page.grow.sum: A crystal shard set on a tank of nutrient solution grows into a geode.
rustcraft.handbook.page.solar.name: Solar Panel
rustcraft.handbook.page.solar.sum: Weak free energy under the open sky: more by day, less at night.
rustcraft.handbook.page.turbine.name: Hydro Turbine
rustcraft.handbook.page.turbine.sum: A block placed right in water. The current flows through its vanes and gives energy. Touching turbines form a structure.
rustcraft.handbook.page.gen_fuel.name: Fuel Generator
rustcraft.handbook.page.gen_fuel.sum: Burns coal, wood and any other furnace fuel.
rustcraft.handbook.page.windmill.name: Windmill
rustcraft.handbook.page.windmill.sum: Energy from the wind. The higher it stands, the more it gives.
rustcraft.handbook.page.gen_lava.name: Lava Generator
rustcraft.handbook.page.gen_lava.sum: Makes energy from lava that comes along a fluid channel.
rustcraft.handbook.page.battery.name: Battery
rustcraft.handbook.page.battery.sum: Stores energy and gives it back when the sources make less than the machines use. Touching batteries form a structure with one store.
rustcraft.handbook.page.alloy.name: Alloy Smelter
rustcraft.handbook.page.alloy.sum: Makes the alloys of tiers two, three and four. Runs on any fuel, as a furnace does, or on energy.
rustcraft.handbook.page.furnace.name: Electric Furnace
rustcraft.handbook.page.furnace.sum: Smelts everything a furnace smelts, with no fuel and twice as fast.
rustcraft.handbook.page.crusher.name: Crusher
rustcraft.handbook.page.crusher.sum: Crushes iron, copper and gold ore to dust: two dusts from one ore, an ingot from each dust.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tank.name: Tank
rustcraft.handbook.page.tank.sum: Holds one fluid. Tanks placed together merge into one big tank.
rustcraft.handbook.page.pump.name: Pump
rustcraft.handbook.page.pump.sum: Takes the water or lava under it and puts it into a fluid channel.
rustcraft.handbook.page.crafter.name: Autocrafter
rustcraft.handbook.page.crafter.sum: Crafts items by recipes. It has pages, one recipe a page.
rustcraft.handbook.page.placer.name: Block Placer
rustcraft.handbook.page.placer.sum: Places a block in the cell in front of it, from its own inventory.
rustcraft.handbook.page.trash.name: Trash
rustcraft.handbook.page.trash.sum: Destroys for good the items and fluids the magistral brings it: the storage's surplus and what its joint's filter lets through.
rustcraft.handbook.page.disintegrator.su: Takes complex items apart into their recipe's ingredients and gives back half of each.
rustcraft.handbook.page.breaker.name: Block Breaker
rustcraft.handbook.page.breaker.sum: Breaks the block in the cell in front of it and keeps what drops.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mixer.name: Mixer
rustcraft.handbook.page.mixer.sum: Makes fluids from water and items: nutrient solution and catalysts.
rustcraft.handbook.page.charger.name: Charger
rustcraft.handbook.page.charger.sum: Charges technical armour and energy weapons.
rustcraft.handbook.page.charge_plate.sum: A thin plate on the floor over a magistral housing. Stand on it and your gear charges fast.
rustcraft.handbook.page.swap.name: Machine tiers and swapping
rustcraft.handbook.page.swap.sum: No need to break a machine to put a better one in its place: click the old one with the new one and they swap.
rustcraft.handbook.page.repair.name: Repair Stand
rustcraft.handbook.page.repair.sum: Mends the game's tools, weapons and armour with the material they are made of. Spends no experience levels.
rustcraft.handbook.page.kitchen.name: Kitchen
rustcraft.handbook.page.kitchen.sum: Cooks by recipe pages, as the autocrafter does: bread, pies, cakes, soups and stews.
rustcraft.handbook.page.fishery.name: Fishing Station
rustcraft.handbook.page.fishery.sum: Set on water, it fishes on its own. A fishing rod goes into its slot; the rod's enchantments work.
rustcraft.handbook.page.feeder.name: Feeder
rustcraft.handbook.page.feeder.sum: Feeds and breeds animals within 4 blocks. Keeps no more than 16 head of each kind.
rustcraft.handbook.page.butcher.name: Butcher
rustcraft.handbook.page.butcher.sum: Culls the spare adult animals of a pen and sends the drops into the magistral: to the storage, the kitchen, crafting.
rustcraft.handbook.page.shearer.name: Shearer-Milker
rustcraft.handbook.page.shearer.sum: Shears sheep and milks cows and goats within 4 blocks. Wool goes into the magistral, milk into a tank.
rustcraft.handbook.page.apiary.name: Apiary Collector
rustcraft.handbook.page.apiary.sum: Takes honey and honeycomb from hives and bee nests nearby. The bees do not get angry.
rustcraft.handbook.page.brewer.name: Brewing Vat
rustcraft.handbook.page.brewer.sum: Brews potions by pages, one potion a page. Takes water bottles and ingredients from the magistral.
rustcraft.handbook.page.xp_tank.name: Experience Condenser
rustcraft.handbook.page.xp_tank.sum: Stores experience levels. A player puts levels in and takes them back out.
rustcraft.handbook.page.enchanter.name: Enchanting Machine
rustcraft.handbook.page.enchanter.sum: Enchants books and items for levels from an experience condenser and lapis. The player picks the level of the enchantment.
rustcraft.handbook.page.archeo.name: Archaeology Table
rustcraft.handbook.page.archeo.sum: Brushes the suspicious sand and gravel a player brings and gives out the finds.
rustcraft.handbook.page.projector.name: Holo-Projector
rustcraft.handbook.page.projector.sum: A builder's helper. Remembers a build in an area and shows the ghost of its blocks. The player takes blocks for it from the storage right at the projector.
rustcraft.handbook.page.builder.name: Building Machine
rustcraft.handbook.page.builder.sum: Builds a projector's build on its own, with blocks from the storage.
rustcraft.handbook.page.modules.name: Machine modules
rustcraft.handbook.page.modules.sum: Upgrades that go into the sockets of a machine's window. Each machine takes its own set of modules.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_speed.name: Speed Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_speed.sum: The machine works twice as fast and uses 2.5 times the energy.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_eco.name: Economy Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_eco.sum: The machine uses 40% less energy and works a little slower.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_cap.name: Capacity Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_cap.sum: More cells in the ingredient queue: the machine keeps raw materials in stock and never idles.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_stack.name: Stack Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_stack.sum: One cell holds more items: in a machine, in the whole storage or in a backpack.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_yield.name: Yield Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_yield.sum: With a 15% chance the machine does not use up an ingredient or gives an extra product.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_store_cap.su: The store of the whole battery structure is 50% larger for each module.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_output.name: Output Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_output.sum: The battery gives out energy faster.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_line.name: Line Boost Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_line.sum: Raises the throughput of the channels on the stretch the node serves.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_scout.name: Scout Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_scout.sum: The miner finds ore in its area faster.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_area.name: Area Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_area.sum: Widens the miner's area: 11×11, then 22×22 and 33×33.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_storage.name: Storage Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_storage.sum: A larger inner store for the miner, a larger buffer for the fishing station, a larger hold for a worker.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_rare.name: Rarity Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_rare.sum: The living vein grows rare ores more often.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_pick.name: Ore Choice Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_pick.sum: Sets which ore the living vein grows. The most expensive module.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_stratum.name: Stratum Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_stratum.sum: The living vein grows suspicious sand or gravel for the archaeology table instead of ore.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_tunnel.name: Corridor Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_tunnel.sum: The bore cuts a wide tunnel: 3×3, 5×5, 7×7 or 9×9.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_height.name: Height Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_height.sum: The bore keeps to a set height and goes neither up nor down.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_lava.name: Lava Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_lava.sum: The bore clears the lava ahead and spends no blocks from its hold on it.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_build.name: Build-up Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_build.sum: The bore fills holes and lines the sides of the tunnel with blocks.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_radius.name: Radius Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_radius.sum: Doubles the working area: of workers, of the animal machines and of the base anchor.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_bleed.name: Bleeding Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_bleed.sum: Every turret shot makes the mob bleed: damage over time that armour does not lessen.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_poison.name: Poison Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_poison.sum: Every turret shot poisons the mob with the game's own poison. Poison does not kill and does not touch the undead.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_slow.name: Slowness Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_slow.sum: Every turret shot slows the mob. Modules add up, but to no more than 60%.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_heal.name: Healing Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_heal.sum: Every 3 seconds a support turret heals the most wounded player in its radius.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_guard.name: Protection Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_guard.sum: Players in a support turret's radius take less damage.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_power.name: Strength Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_power.sum: Players in a support turret's radius hit harder.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_haste.name: Swiftness Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_haste.sum: Players in a support turret's radius move faster.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_recipes.name: Recipe Book
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_recipes.sum: A storage terminal module. Knows every recipe of the game and the mod and lets you order items.
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_filter.name: Filter Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.mod_filter.sum: Sets the own tab of the storage terminal: only the items it marks.
rustcraft.handbook.page.cell.name: Storage Cell
rustcraft.handbook.page.cell.sum: A storage block. Cells make up a solid box of any size.
rustcraft.handbook.page.terminal.name: Storage Terminal
rustcraft.handbook.page.terminal.sum: One window for the whole storage: search, filter tabs, every slot, limits by item. With the recipe book it takes orders.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tablet.name: Storage Tablet
rustcraft.handbook.page.tablet.sum: Opens the storage from anywhere in the base, with no wires.
rustcraft.handbook.page.monorail.name: Monorail
rustcraft.handbook.page.monorail.sum: A rail that fixes to any face of a block: floor, wall and ceiling, and runs vertically.
rustcraft.handbook.page.station.name: Station
rustcraft.handbook.page.station.sum: A named block. Shows the scheme of the rail network and sends a capsule to the chosen point.
rustcraft.handbook.page.capsule.name: Capsule
rustcraft.handbook.page.capsule.sum: A passenger cart. It appears at a station and is gone on arrival.
rustcraft.handbook.page.lift.name: Lift
rustcraft.handbook.page.lift.sum: A vertical monorail with a station on each floor.
rustcraft.handbook.page.chassis.name: Worker Chassis
rustcraft.handbook.page.chassis.sum: The base of a worker cart. One tool and upgrades go into its window.
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_unload.name: Unload Dock
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_unload.sum: Takes the load of a cart that stopped beside it and gives it to the magistral or a chest next to it.
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_load.name: Load Dock
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_load.sum: Loads a cargo cart with items from the magistral or a chest next to it.
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_charge.name: Charge Dock
rustcraft.handbook.page.dock_charge.sum: Charges the battery of a worker that stopped beside it.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_saw.name: Tool: Saw
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_saw.sum: Makes the chassis a lumberjack cart: it fells the trees beside its way and plants new ones.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_reaper.name: Tool: Reaper
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_reaper.sum: Makes the chassis a reaper cart: it harvests ripe crops beside its way and sows them again.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_hold.name: Tool: Cargo Hold
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_hold.sum: Makes the chassis a cargo cart: it mines nothing and carries items from a load dock to an unload dock.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_grab.name: Tool: Grab
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_grab.sum: Makes the chassis a collector cart: it breaks ore blocks beside its way and picks up items lying there.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_bore.name: Tool: Tunneler Bore
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_bore.sum: Makes the chassis a tunneller: it bores a tunnel and lays the monorail in it on its own.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_gun.name: Tool: Shooter
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_gun.sum: Makes the chassis a guard cart: it patrols its stretch and attacks hostile mobs.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_scoop.name: Tool: Scoop
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_scoop.sum: Makes the chassis a digger cart: it digs dirt, sand, gravel and clay beside its way.
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_map.name: Tool: Cartographer
rustcraft.handbook.page.tool_map.sum: Makes the chassis a cartographer: it rides the monorail and puts the chunks, biomes and structures beside its way on the stations' scheme.
rustcraft.handbook.page.upgrades.name: Worker upgrades
rustcraft.handbook.page.upgrades.sum: Items that go into the chassis window beside the tool.
rustcraft.handbook.page.portal_dock.name: Portal Dock
rustcraft.handbook.page.portal_dock.sum: A pair of blocks by the portals of two worlds. What goes into one dock comes out of the other.
rustcraft.handbook.page.miner.name: Miner
rustcraft.handbook.page.miner.sum: Draws the ore out of an 11×11 area under it, from its own level down to bedrock. The ground keeps its shape.
rustcraft.handbook.page.vein.name: Living Vein
rustcraft.handbook.page.vein.sum: Grows random ore blocks around it from stone and energy.
rustcraft.handbook.page.anchor.name: Base Anchor
rustcraft.handbook.page.anchor.sum: Keeps its chunk loaded while its owner is on the server. With radius modules, up to 5×5 chunks.
rustcraft.handbook.page.turret.name: Turret
rustcraft.handbook.page.turret.sum: Shoots hostile mobs in its radius. Effect modules add bleeding, poison and slowness to its shot; a support module makes it a helper that heals and strengthens players.
rustcraft.handbook.page.armor.name: Technical Armour
rustcraft.handbook.page.armor.sum: Four armour pieces: helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots. Each has a battery and sockets for player modules. Three tiers: sparksteel, crystallite and starsteel.
rustcraft.handbook.page.pmodules.name: Player modules
rustcraft.handbook.page.pmodules.sum: Abilities in the sockets of technical armour: dash, run, jump, soft landing. They run on its charge.
rustcraft.handbook.page.jetpack.name: Jetpack Module
rustcraft.handbook.page.jetpack.sum: A module for the technical chestplate. Free flight while the chestplate holds charge.
rustcraft.handbook.page.blade.name: Energy Blade
rustcraft.handbook.page.blade.sum: A sword that spends its battery's charge instead of durability. Three tiers: sparksteel, crystallite and starsteel.
rustcraft.handbook.page.eshield.name: Energy Shield
rustcraft.handbook.page.eshield.sum: A shield that spends charge instead of durability. Blocks hits and projectiles from the front, as a shield does.
rustcraft.handbook.page.rifle.name: Energy Rifle
rustcraft.handbook.page.rifle.sum: A fourth tier weapon. An instant straight shot of 64 blocks for its battery's charge.
rustcraft.handbook.page.scout_compass.su: An explorer's helper. Points to the nearest structure or biome a cartographer found and you have not visited yet.
rustcraft.handbook.page.backpack.name: Backpack
rustcraft.handbook.page.backpack.sum: A bag with an inventory of its own. Opens with a key or a right click. The last tier is worn in a slot of its own on the back.
rustcraft.handbook.page.harpoon.name: Harpoon
rustcraft.handbook.page.harpoon.sum: Hooks onto a block and pulls you to it. If the space over the block is free, you climb onto it.
rustcraft.handbook.page.zipline.name: Zipline
rustcraft.handbook.page.zipline.sum: Stretches a rope to the block you aim at, and you ride along it. A safe way up a ledge and down.
rustcraft.handbook.page.guide.name: Engineer's Handbook
rustcraft.handbook.page.guide.sum: This handbook in the game: a page on every block and item.
rustcraft.handbook.page.enchants.name: Technical enchantments
rustcraft.handbook.page.enchants.sum: Enchantments for technical armour. They always come as a book: you see what is in it and put it on at an anvil.
rustcraft.handbook.page.alloys.name: Alloys
rustcraft.handbook.page.alloys.sum: Four alloys, one a tier. The first is made on a crafting table, the others in the alloy smelter.
rustcraft.handbook.page.shard.name: Crystal Shard
rustcraft.handbook.page.shard.sum: Drops from the crystal geodes underground.
rustcraft.handbook.page.dusts.name: Ore dust
rustcraft.handbook.page.dusts.sum: Iron, copper and gold dust from the crusher. Smelts into an ingot.
rustcraft.handbook.page.fluids.name: Solution and catalysts
rustcraft.handbook.page.fluids.sum: Fluids from the mixer. Nutrient solution feeds crystal structures; catalysts boost machines.
